messages:
opsbot: [ALERT] apac1 transit to ISP-Blue showing sustained packet loss ~7-9% over last 6m. Observed p99 inference latency increasing and backend 502/504 spikes.

aisha: oncall Aisha here. pulling BGP state, node health, and CDN edge logs now.

carlos: quick note: remote shows RPKI invalids and frequent withdraws from ISP-Blue peers. looks like upstream edge congestion, not our router.

mike: tentative plan: 1) shift low-priority/batch traffic from apac1 -> eu1 2) enable edgeproxy fallback on apac1 for critical routes to avoid CDN 502s 3) gracefully drain impacted GPU nodes 4) watch cross-region egress cost (alert if > $5k/day).

sre-oncall: kicking off traffic-shift playbook: /playbooks/shift-traffic --from apac1 --to eu1 --selector=workload:best-effort

sre-oncall: quick healthcheck to apac gateway pool:
```
for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -m2 https://apac1-gw.redwood-inference.net/health || echo "fail $i"; sleep 1; done
```

sre-oncall: results: 4/10 failures in 30s window, p95 latency ~680ms. marking pools gpu-pool-apac1-a and gpu-pool-apac1-b as affected.

carlos: bgp dump snippet: 
```
# show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.3 received-routes
* 203.0.113.0/24  invalid (origin+prepends)  withdraws: 12
```

mike: options: spin short-burst alt-cloud capacity in apac-alt (2x A100) vs bulk shift to eu1. tradeoff: alt-cloud cheaper for brief recovery, but eu1 faster for wider capacity.

aisha: alt-cloud boots in 8-12m and has only ~6 GPUs total. eu1 reserved pools can accept traffic in ~4-6m. recommend eu1 for bulk non-critical shift.

julia: product question: which customers end up affected? any SLA cliffs? we need to send customer comms if >10% requests exceed 500ms over 15m.

aisha: checking routing mix: apac1 carried ~18% of prod tokens last 30m; ~40% of that is batch/embeddings. initial target: move ~7% of total (non-critical) off apac1.

mike: implement route-weight to bias eu1 80/20 for selector workload:best-effort.

sre-oncall: API call executed: 
POST /admin/routing/update 
{ "selector":"workload:best-effort", "origin_weights": {"apac1": 20, "eu1": 80} } 
(job id ts-1734567890-1)

deploy-bot: routing-update job ts-1734567890-1 started by sre-oncall

aisha: enabling prefix/KV cache priming on eu1 to reduce cold token cost for shifted flows.

carlos: applied edgeproxy fallback on apac1: http-proxy -> edge-peers (limits: 100r/s/origin). should cut 502s at CDN layer.

customer-notify-bot: drafted customer advisory for APAC-region users. please review before publish.

julia: include impact metrics and expected ETA for recovery. once metrics attached, ok to post.

sre-oncall: current impact: p50 +25ms, p95 +420ms, some tails 700-1200ms. error rate for long embeddings/timeouts rose from 0.2% -> 1.7% in last 10m.

mike: cost projection: if sustained, shifting 18% traffic to eu1 adds ~ $6.5k/day cross-region egress. alt-cloud short-burst estimate: ~$1.2k for 12h. choose eu1 for speed, monitor burn.

aisha: starting graceful drain on gpu-pool-apac1-a (10 nodes). draining commands: 
```
kubectl label node gpu-apac1-a01 redwood/drain=true && kubectl cordon gpu-apac1-a01
```
5/10 nodes drained so far; workloads moving to eu1.

sre-oncall: apac request backlog reduced from 320 -> 120 within 8m after routing change.

carlos: ISP-Blue acknowledges an upstream transit event, investigating possible DDoS. they estimate ~1h to remediation. escalation ticket IB-8921 opened.

julia: prepare external status update: TL;DR: upstream ISP transit degradation causing elevated APAC latency; mitigations in place (non-critical shift + fallbacks). ETA 1-2h.

aisha: documenting runbook steps and add cost guardrails. tagging incident for postmortem owners.

sre-oncall: muting noisy p95 alerts during mitigation, keeping pages for p99 and error rate spikes.

mike: if no upstream fix in 45m, plan B: full shift of traffic and enable quantization-fallback for long generations to lower token volume and latency.

aisha: requested +12 GPUs in eu1 reserved pool (req 9876). provisioning ETA ~5m.

deploy-bot: reserved-pool scale request 9876 accepted; provisioning started.

sre-oncall: mitigation status: partial traffic shift successful, major customer impact limited to increased latency for long-running requests. monitoring and will update every 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

opsbot: incident created INC-2026-APAC-TRANSIT-1734567890, severity: sev2

julia: once p95 stabilizes, publish status page and notify CS with impact numbers.

aisha: next update in 15m or immediately on major change. ping me for urgent escalations.

carlos: ISP update: removed temporary route filters, packet loss down to ~2% last 3m. keep mitigations for 30m of stability.

sre-oncall: last check: p95 ~210ms, error rate ~0.35%. keeping drained nodes offline for safety. transitioning to monitoring/recovery.

aisha: action items: 1) postmortem owners: aisha, carlos, mike; 2) cost analysis card; 3) validate smart-router rollback tests.

mike: thanks team, great execution :thumbsup:
